problem_title: The alternating Turán-type inequality for normalized Euler numbers

evidence.text:
We prove Sokal Conjecture 3.3 for every starting index n>=0 and positive shifts j,k, using the actual normalized Taylor coefficients of sec(t)+tan(t). Classical partial fractions, a uniform positive-error contraction and four parity cases establish the sign. The generating-function identity, all coefficient bridges and the complete source inequality are proved in Lean.See full solutionHide full solutionWe prove Sokal Conjecture 3.3 for every starting index n>=0 and positive shifts j,k, using the actual normalized Taylor coefficients of sec(t)+tan(t).
